designSystemScope: Separate physical Figma design-system board for KineticCast only, documenting dark broadcast tokens, homepage modules, media placeholders, component states, and editable source hygiene.

typographyTokens.display: Inter 72/0, Extra Bold, tight broadcast hero
typographyTokens.h1: Inter 56/0, Extra Bold, dark editorial headline
typographyTokens.bodySmall: Inter 14/0, Regular, support copy and metadata
typographyTokens.label: Inter 12/0, Semi Bold uppercase, signal and status chips
typographyTokens.button: Inter 15/0, Semi Bold, urgent broadcast action

spacingTokens.sectionY: 96 desktop section rhythm with dense console sections using 72
spacingTokens.cardGap: 18 event rows, 24 cards, 32 large proof modules

components: header navigation with trial button and streaming quality chip
button primary, secondary, ghost, icon CTA, disabled state
card event stream, sport category, replay article, analytics proof, fan room, pricing pass
image placeholder: live stream hero screen
profile photo placeholder: fan watch party avatar

componentAnatomy.navigation header: logo mark, navigation links, status chip, trial button, mobile-safe spacing
componentAnatomy.button: label, optional icon zone, action fill, border focus ring, disabled contrast state
componentAnatomy.card: surface, border, title, metadata row, placeholder/media zone, CTA or metric footer
componentAnatomy.cta: headline, supporting copy, primary action, secondary proof cue, red command surface
componentAnatomy.footer: brand block, link columns, support copy, legal row
componentAnatomy.placeholder: visible text clue naming the media purpose; no generated final imagery embedded

patternModules: broadcast command hero with editable console placeholder
live arena room with event rows
usageRules: Use action red only for conversion, live-status emphasis, and critical selected states.
Keep dark surfaces layered with borders and inset panels rather than flat black blocks.
All image zones stay editable text placeholders in the source template.
Do not reuse this broadcast-console hero grammar for the travel template.
Major sections, cards, rows, CTA groups, and design-system modules use real auto-layout.

surfaceEffectTokens.panelShadow: soft dark shadow under raised broadcast surfaces
surfaceEffectTokens.focusRing: red hairline outline for selected or interactive zones
surfaceEffectTokens.proofGlow: subtle warm amber emphasis only for proof metrics
surfaceEffectTokens.borderDepth: low-contrast oxblood borders to separate nested console surfaces

placeholderRules.media: Use `image placeholder: [purpose]` inside stream, replay, chart, and app-preview areas.
placeholderRules.people: Use `profile photo placeholder: [role]` for fan or host avatars.
placeholderRules.charts: Use chart placeholder labels and simple editable line hints.
placeholderRules.restriction: No final generated photos are embedded unless explicitly requested.

sourceHygiene.notes: Homepage and design-system frames use named section layers and modular auto-layout; decorative depth is isolated from editable content.
